author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Jordan Grimmer-Tufik 

First of all thank you so much. I plan to do ulpan in the future, but right now I’m working full time so it’s a bit difficult.
My bf also teaches me and he’s quite strict. Sometimes just one word takes me ten tries because he wants my pronunciation to be as accurate as possible so I don’t learn it wrong. It can be frustrating at times because it feels hard for me but I understand his intention. Even though he’s patient.
It’s funny because I used to watch HebrewPod101 all the time too 😂 Thank you for the recommendation I’ll definitely check out the channel you mentioned. 🙏🙏🙏
